Print, or with --install add, the `Host termag-*` entry for ~/.ssh/config.

Usage: termag ssh-config [--install] [--wake]

Then `ssh termag-<box>`, scp, rsync and editor Remote-SSH reach every box you own, and
`ssh termag-<box>.<project>` (or `.ctrl`) attaches to a project's agent (or ctrl shell).
Re-run it after adding a box or a project.
With --wake, connecting to a stopped or hibernated box starts it first. An editor
that reconnects on its own then keeps a parked box up, so it is off by default.

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
